div.div:
APPLCATION NOTE (apply to all module)
Application will be containerize
+ eventually, will add test (Unit/ Intergrating test) bring test coverage to 70%
+ When scaled already plan for ulti tier data base.
+ Plan to add load balancer later
+ Front end Angular v17
+Auth0
+ UI optimistic update, + eventually normalise using notification system.
+ Front end interact with backend via api gateway
+ Each Module will have a version build into theit API end point
+ Each module, client(for client(active user it will also include traceId compose of userId + client type) will be assigned a traceId

2.Single nodeRedis have outbox (for handle failure) - so it have ability to heal connection drop, redis restart and allow for intervention
during outage (by recover module)
3. Rabit Mq is splitting to different exchange base off of domain. they will have DLQ on demand (requrie by business requirement)
---
For current loging: each new login will cache the user as active (with ttl until flag as log out) - no Access / refresh machanism yet.
